rationale: Only problem with literature headroom of many delta under the same verifier AND a way to reach it tonight. Two kinds of candidates, kept apart (see best_candidate_by_track). Track A, provenance milo_published_copy: MILO (arXiv:2609.38349, App. E) claims 1.4488860143 on 25,600 grid points with the arena verifier, 22 delta below the live #1; its construction is not public, but its project page publishes 3,200 of the 25,600 values (6 decimals), which score 1.6558 as given. Block-repeated x8 and re-optimized with log-sum-exp cooling paths and hops (our re-implementation, minutes on one core), that copy gives candidates more than 28 delta below the live #1 and more than 6 delta below MILO's claimed value. Track B, provenance public_leaderboard_only: the live #1 itself (solution 2617), block-averaged to 3,200 values, repeated x8 and re-optimized with hops, gives candidates at least delta below the live #1 with no MILO data; the margin is thin and track B stays about 21 delta above MILO's claim. Every candidate is scored by the pinned verifier in a clean process and by an independent exact-rational scorer (agreement within 1.3e-15). Polishing the live #1 directly gains 0 delta. Whether a MILO-derived result is acceptable is Arthur's call; track B does not depend on it. The schema allows at most 100,000 values, and CPU is enough.

rationale: Strongest sign of headroom after the lead: the record moved by 2.55e-6 (2,550 delta) four days ago and by 4.6e-5 over 60 days, through five successive record holders since 2026-09-08; delta is 1e-9. 128 variables, exact rational verifier, and the leaderboard is ahead of the literature (0.107067, the Station). The method that worked is described: group moves (resize, transfer, reflect groups of nearby directions) alternated with relaxation of all offsets, accepting temporary increases. Not tested here; stage 3's generic probe found no gain in 10 minutes at 1.07 s per evaluation, so it needs a fast float event scorer first. The platform marks statement and verifier 'under active review'.
